The current applicable commission rate may be viewed in your Affiliate account and commission rates may be changed at any time by Red Dane.

The commission is paid only on orders that can be tracked (by using a unique Affiliate link) and reported by Red Dane's Affiliate Program system powered by Secomapp. In order to properly track any referral order, the customer must have their cookies enabled on their web browser. Refunded payments due to returns, fraud or any other reason do not qualify for commission fees. To the extent a customer receives a refund, no commission shall be paid to the Affiliate.

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a visitor doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track their orders and so can't pay earnings to you on that visitor's activity.

Cookie Days is stipulated on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a visitor clicks on the affiliate's link or uses the coupon.
